proof_body:
by
  intro ω y v hy hv s t
  have he : (fun u => v u ^ 2 + ω ^ 2 * y u ^ 2) = fun u => v u * v u + ω ^ 2 * (y u * y u) := by
    funext u
    ring
  have hE : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => v u ^ 2 + ω ^ 2 * y u ^ 2) 0 u := by
    intro u
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u => v u * v u + ω ^ 2 * (y u * y u))
        (-(ω ^ 2 * y u) * v u + v u * -(ω ^ 2 * y u) +
          ω ^ 2 * (v u * y u + y u * v u)) u :=
      ((hv u).mul (hv u)).add (((hy u).mul (hy u)).const_mul (ω ^ 2))
    rw [he]
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun u => (hE u).differentiableAt) (fun u => (hE u).deriv) t s
target_source: ∀ (ω : ℝ) (y v : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt y (v t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt v (-(ω ^ 2 * y t)) t) → ∀ s t, v t ^ 2 + ω ^ 2 * y t ^ 2 = v s ^ 2 + ω ^ 2 * y s ^ 2
